captions_note: the tiles, receipts and total are the effect itself, not captions: the reel's captions keep running through the slot. Before building, set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption / overall style (typeface, case, weight, colours, order of wall spots)
in_a_reel: RECEIPTS_ON stays False unless the speaker names amounts; the total is the sum of the receipts and is never typed
start the slot 6 frames or more before the first name and leave 12 frames after the last piece: build.py says how many frames it needs. Leave F_IN / F_OUT at None so both edges are the plain picture
after ANY change to the CLIP block run prep.py again and LOOK at work/layout.jpg: no piece on a window, shelf or furniture (set WALL), none shrunk under 0.8
steps: do ask which names go on the tiles and, for receipts, which amounts: only names and amounts the speaker says in this clip or the buyer gave you. Never invent a name, a price or a count, never draw a logo. No spoken list = leave Knockout Tiles out and say so
run prep.py words      # 1. every word with its frame -> edit STYLE and CLIP in build.py
run prep.py      # 2. measures the cutout, places every piece -> work/layout.jpg (LOOK)
run build.py SAFE=1      # 3. page with the guide; prints every beat and the snapshot times
run check.py      # 5. frame count, plain edges, face, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
